name: planfig-mods
description: One pack of Claude Code mods: the painel (one band above the prompt with turn, speed, cost, context, prompt-cache countdown, plan and subagents, plus a /painel detail pane), the savvy-flow-plus orchestrator with five tiered workers, and a codex skill.

language.title: Painel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en or pt

ttl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
ttl.description: auto follows Claude Code's rules (FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, promptCacheTtl, ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H, then 1 hour on a subscription and 5 minutes otherwise) and corrects itself from request timing; 5m or 1h pins it

toast.title: Cache toasts
toast.description: A toast when the prompt cache enters its last sixth and when it expires (prompts of 20k tokens or more, never while a turn runs)

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.description: Soft sounds when Claude asks a question, a plan step fails and a plan finishes

rules.title: Plan rule in the system prompt
rules.description: Tell Claude to report multi-step work with painel_plan
